inventory.sourceFigureDescription: The p. 76 gluconeogenesis section is text + enzyme entries (no printed figure): pyruvate carboxylase (In mitochondria. Pyruvate → oxaloacetate. Requires biotin, ATP. Activated by acetyl-CoA.), PEPCK (In cytosol. Oxaloacetate → PEP. Requires GTP.), fructose-1,6-bisphosphatase 1 (In cytosol. F-1,6-BP → F-6-P. Citrate ⊕, AMP ⊝, fructose 2,6-bisphosphate ⊝.), glucose-6-phosphatase (In ER. G-6-P → glucose.) plus the organ-distribution and odd/even-chain paragraphs.

notes: The source presents the four enzymes as table entries, not a figure; the adaptation renders them as a compartment pathway (mitochondria → cytosol → ER) with verbatim reactions, requirements, and regulators, plus the organ panel and odd/even-chain panel. Dotted spans mark where the source lists no enzyme (no intermediates fabricated).
